The '''Imperial Opera House''', formerly known as the '''Mala Opera House''' was an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house that was built centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was constructed of marble, and was connected to the street by one hundred steps. On each side of the steps stood twelve five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall statues.<ref name="OaA1" />

After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took over Ord Radama, they declared that only Imperial-sanctioned performances would be allowed and renamed the opera house. Additionally, an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence Service]] [[Imperial Intelligence Service command center|command center]] was built under the opera house, although its presence was not public.<ref name="OaA1" />
